en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act1_main1: An unsure Mercia faces her first test as monarch of Cherrystone.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act1_main2: The Felheim invasion begins in earnest.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act1_main3: Unhappy with her defeat, Ragna decides to take matters into her own hands.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act1_main4: With Cherrystone overwhelmed, Mercia must get her people to safety.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act2_main1: The party escapes to the Gloomwoods, only to face fresh dangers.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act2_main2: With Sedge defeated, Emeric faces a new Floran threat.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act2_side1: Alone in the woods, Caesar finds some villagers in need of aid.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act2_side2: Having just met, Nuru and Mercia decide to test each other's mettle.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act2_side3: Unhappy with Sedge's deception, Greenfinger confronts the wayward commander.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act3_main1: Mercia's journey is interrupted by an enemy she thought she'd left behind.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act3_main2: Deep in the Lost Leagues, Emeric decides strange times call for strange magic.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act3_main3: They've taken everything the Lost Leagues had to throw at them, except this final foe.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act3_side1: Caesar once again encounters those pesky outlaws.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act3_side2: Ragna's blood is up and she's itching for a fight. Any enemy will do.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act4_main1: Their destination reached, our heroes find the Heavensong border guards less than hospitable.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act4_main2: Having fallen to Nuru, the Heavensong border soldiers call in their commander.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act4_main3: Ryota is defeated, but here comes Koji. Emeric steps in to take on the plucky prince.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act4_side1: An abashed Ryota tries to explain himself.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act4_side2: Two old friends relive the happy days of their youth.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act5_main1: Now allies, Emeric and Koji band together to take on a shadowy foe they thought they had eluded.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act5_main2: Mercia and the others arrive to meet their fleet, only to find the port overrun.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act5_side1: Time for Caesar to rally the troops again; the outlaws are up to their old tricks.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act5_side2: Ryota looks to settle a long-standing score.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act5_side3: If you ask Nuru there's always time for fun, and what's more fun than taking down a rampant giant?
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act6_main1: Mercia has set sail for Felheim, but our heroes aren't the only ones who have taken to the sea.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act6_main2: Ragna is sunk, but an army awaits our heroes on the shores of Felheim.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act6_main3: Emeric and the gang have held off Valder's forces, but now Mercia must face The Fell Lord.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act6_side1: They really thought they were safe this time, but the outlaws are in for a surprise.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act6_side2: Nothing stands between Sigrid and what she wants.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act7_main1: Valder has joined the allies, and it's time for Mercia to face Sigrid.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_act7_main2: With Sigrid and her plan put to rest, our heroes face a yet mightier foe.
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_epilogue: Elodie is gone, but Requiem remains. What will Mercia do?
en-GB.campaign_mapdescription_prologue: Under cover of night, High Vampire Sigrid makes a daring attack on Cherrystone Castle.
